body:
The key-leak morning: a seed file was on a laptop that is gone, and the operator needs one
answer — every author with standing, which grant, which verb, granted when, struck when. Today
connectors have `loam grant list`; pens have nothing (§45.4 names the provisioned-vs-granted
listing as an open remainder); user write grants have nothing. The morning is spent reading raw
deltas.

Build: extend `loam grant list` into the full ledger. One table over the existing grant deltas
(the CTX_GRANTS vocabulary) joined with what the home directory knows: users (user.<name>.seed),
pens (pen.<name>.seed), and connector records. Each row: kind (user/pen/connector), name, derived
author key (abbreviated), verb, granted-at, and struck-at when a strike exists. Struck grants are
SHOWN struck, never omitted — an omitted strike is exactly the hole the morning is spent
finding. Keep it CLI-only, matching the §36 standing decision that user management lives in the
CLI.

Grounding the builder needs: an operator-role user is granted the `admin` verb
(src/cli/cli.ts — the user-create path); a plain actor user gets NO grant and NO
user.<name>.seed file, so criterion (a)'s user row must use an operator-role user. And the
kind enum cannot cover every grant in the ground: an admin-minted grant for an arbitrary key
matches no seed file and no connector record — such rows render with kind `unattributed` and
are NEVER omitted (the ledger's whole point is that nothing with standing hides).

Overlap note: spec/45 §45.4 assigns the provisioned-vs-granted listing to T102's remainder,
which suggested `loam store` as the surface. This ticket decides the surface is the ledger;
the post-landing re-evaluation pass trims T102's stale half.

Acceptance criteria — all via CLI tests in a mkdtemp home:
(a) A store with a user, a pen, and a connector lists all three, each with kind, verb, and
    derived author. Verify: new test test/cli/grant-ledger.test.ts.
(b) A struck grant appears with its struck-at marker AND a live bystander grant renders
    WITHOUT the marker (two-sided at the row level — the two-sidedness cannot evaporate if
    no filter is built). Verify: same file.
(c) A seed file present in the home with no grant in the ground is listed as provisioned-but-
    ungranted — the §45.4 gap, closed. Verify: same file.
(d) The ledger is a read: running it appends no deltas. Verify: same file, delta-count
    unchanged assertion.

Merge tier: repair — a report made more honest; nothing new gains standing.
title: The grant ledger — every author with standing, on one screen
